patthana23.9:1.1: na kusalaṃ na ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.9:2.1: na kusalaṃ na apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.9:3.1: na kusalaṃ na nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. nakusalattika nasekkhattike kusalattika sekkhattikaṃ
